scripts.typecheck:production: tsc --noEmit --target ES2020 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --types node scripts/security-guards.ts
scripts.ci:pinocchio: pnpm run check:production-wiring && pnpm run typecheck:production && pnpm run build:pinocchio && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:hostile-jupiter
scripts.test:unit: cd programs/burner && rustup run 1.89.0-sbpf-solana-v1.53 cargo test
scripts.fuzz:host: cd programs/burner && rustup run 1.89.0-sbpf-solana-v1.53 cargo test --lib -- fuzz
scripts.test:split: npx tsx scripts/split-negative.ts && npx tsx scripts/split-permissionless.ts && npx tsx scripts/split-matrix.ts
scripts.test:vc: npx tsx scripts/vc-validate-config.ts && npx tsx scripts/vc-consistency.ts
scripts.typecheck:quote-service: tsc --noEmit --target ES2020 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --types node,mocha,chai quote-service/core.ts quote-service/reference.ts quote-service/markets.ts quote-service/adapters.ts quote-service/cli.ts quote-service/server.ts quote-service/core.test.ts quote-service/reference.test.ts quote-service/server.test.ts quote-service/adapters.test.ts quote-service/directcurve.test.ts quote-service/markets.test.ts
scripts.test:quote-service: TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 mocha -r ts-node/register -t 20000 quote-service/core.test.ts quote-service/reference.test.ts quote-service/server.test.ts quote-service/adapters.test.ts quote-service/directcurve.test.ts quote-service/markets.test.ts
scripts.test:hostile-jupiter-fuzz: HOSTILE_FUZZ_ITERS=${HOSTILE_FUZZ_ITERS:-3000} rustup run 1.89.0-sbpf-solana-v1.53 cargo test --manifest-path programs/burner/Cargo.toml --test hostile_keyless_jupiter keyless_hostile_jupiter_fuzz -- --ignored --nocapture

name: onchainburner
description: An immutable Solana burner vault. A vault's configuration is its PDA address: there is no configuration account, update instruction, or withdrawal path. The production program converts vault SOL through Jupiter and atomically burns the configured target tokens.
